name: guto-skills
description: Composable engineering graph orchestration with Gauntlet pre-planning and vendored Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, verify, and review with focused local context.
interface.longDescription: Guto Skills provides four freely composable graph nodes. Guto Plan can turn a goal and inspectable quality bar into a concise Gauntlet prompt for a fresh planning agent, while callers retain control of routing, pauses, and exit conditions.
defaultPrompt: Use guto-plan to create an approved implementation plan from the real repository context
Use guto-plan to generate a concise Gauntlet prompt and quality bar for a fresh planning agent
Use guto-review to reconstruct context and review a verified change for merge readiness
